name: Shinny Pond Hockey
subtitle: Pond hockey, no goalies
shortDescription: Skate with a thumb, flick and bank the puck off snow banks: eight ponds, a 24-stop circuit and 24 skill drills.
longDescription:
Shinny is pond hockey as it is played on a frozen lake: no goalies, no checks, just ice, angles and a puck that goes where you flick it. Lace up.

Skate with one thumb. Press anywhere and drag; the longer the drag, the faster you skate. Skates carve, so wide arcs keep your speed and a hard cut at full tilt can pop the puck off your stick. Sprint, watch the stamina bar and brake when you need to.

Flick it and bank it. Swipe and lift: the swipe is your shot, and direction, power and accuracy all come from your finger. The puck rebounds off snow banks, boulders and posts, so bank shots are a real weapon. Tap a team-mate to pass. Tap in front of a carrier to poke the puck away.

Eight ponds are each different: Cedar Pond at noon, Birch Bay at dusk, Lantern Lake at night, rough drifted marsh ice, a boulder-guarded mill pond, a narrow quarry, a huge lake and an aurora bay. Quick ice, snow patches and obstacles change how the puck and your skates behave.

Play one-on-one or two-on-two against five levels of computer team, from Rookie to Legend. A 24-stop Pond Circuit has star goals, and 24 skill drills cover target shots, bank shots, slalom and breakaways. A new Daily Target Shot arrives every day, eight short lessons teach the moves, and thirty trophies and a rink page record your stats.

Auto Play lets you watch the computer play with Pause, Think and Take over.

Free with ads. Go ad-free with a monthly pass, or earn ad-free time from videos.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
